[[Lisa Ortiz]] (Miles) |java=Nozomi Sasaki }} '''Townes''', '''Hoyt''', and '''Miles''' (Japanese: '''レモンキッズ''' ''Lemon Kids'') are minor characters who appeared in ''[[M21|The Power of Us]]''. The three of them run a lemonade stand in [[Fula City]]. ==History== Townes, Hoyt, and Miles were first seen running a lemonade stand in [[Fula City]]. While moving their operation, [[Margo]] bumped into them and they lost several of their lemons. Annoyed, they threw a lemon at her, only for {{OBP|Ash Ketchum|M20|Ash}} to catch it. They sent {{p|Phanpy}} out to battle {{OBP|Ash's Pikachu|M20|Pikachu}}, only for it to be quickly defeated. Ash asked if they were interested in a second round, but the three boys left in a hurry. Townes, Hoyt, and Miles were later seen helping the other civilians clean up the city. They informed [[Risa]] and the others about {{OBP|Zeraora|M21}}'s curse, but Margo dismissed their tale as fake. ==Character== Townes, Hoyt, and Miles are a boisterous group of boys that often hang out together. The trio enjoys a good laugh and they often discuss the strange rumors surrounding [[Fula City]]. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} This listing is of Townes, Hoyt, and Miles's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: ===On hand (Hoyt)=== {{TrainerPoké |pkmn=Phanpy |trainer=Lemon Kids |type1=Ground |img=Hoyt Phanpy.png |epnum=M21 |epname=The Power of Us |vaen=Haven Paschall |vajp= |desc={{p|Phanpy}} is Hoyt's only known Pokémon. It was present as they carted around their lemon stand. Phanpy was used to {{pkmn|battle}} {{OBP|Ash Ketchum|M20|Ash}}, going up against {{OBP|Ash's Pikachu|M20|Pikachu}}. Hoyt was initially confident of his victory, but Pikachu quickly dodged Phanpy's Rollout which caused Phanpy to roll into Miles because of its extra momentum. A follow-up {{m|Iron Tail}} knocked both Phanpy and Miles out, ending the match.
